method: Independent binary FBX audit plus actual Blender importer round-trip. Source is canonical Y-up XYZ. Approved visible presentation uses a Unity camera at +Z with screen-right=-X: sector 6 at root -X, 11 at root +X, 20 at +Y. Scoring coordinates are unchanged; a future visual adapter maps (-LastX, LastY, 0.055). Serialized FBX is intentionally X-reflected with winding reversed; expected Unity coordinates apply X reflection again, based on separately observed Unity importer behavior. This script does not execute Unity and does not label predicted Unity results as actual Unity verification.
